versions.guide:
Bring the Elder to the Clan

The Honorable Elder will follow his liberator, but is too weakened by imprisonment that he can defend himself.
versions.html:
The Honourable Elder

You must bring the Elder to the camp. If he dies, you should still go to the Green Clan and tell your story to the Chief.

Objectives

Bring the Elder to the Clan
